discrepancies.description: First Test target TGT_00016774 has a WB0-authorized predecessor from TGT_00016773 (last Validation target).
discrepancies.impact: Allows first Test target to receive a classified R3/R4 regime label; otherwise it would be UNCLASSIFIED.
discrepancies.resolution: Documented and used exactly as authorized; no threshold derived from Test.

discrepancies.description: Q25_y and Q75_y fall on discrete Appliances Wh values (50, 100) due to the integer discretization of the dataset.
discrepancies.impact: Some Test target_ids may share a regime boundary value. We use strict comparison (y < Q25, y < Q75, y >= Q90) consistently.

discrepancies.description: LSTM_TUNED_DEV is NOT_ELIGIBLE_CONFIG_MISMATCH per Phase 47 canonical status.
discrepancies.impact: No LSTM regime metrics; documented as NOT_APPLICABLE.
discrepancies.resolution: No inference, no retrain, no fabrication; canonical status respected.

discrepancies.description: Q90_abs_delta = 80.0 falls on a discrete Appliances Wh delta.
discrepancies.impact: Same as D50-02; we use strict inequality (abs(delta) < 80.0 for NORMAL, abs(delta) >= 80.0 for RAPID).

discrepancies.description: Persistence is computed from a single Phase 47 prediction file (no seed diversity).
discrepancies.evidence: final_test_predictions_persistence.csv carries one row per target_id with seed=blank.
discrepancies.impact: Persistence per-regime metrics are single-point estimates; no seed SD reported.
discrepancies.resolution: Documented; no impact on cross-seed Transformer aggregation.

discrepancies.description: R² = NOT_DEFINED for R3 CHANGE_MAGNITUDE because target variance for some sub-regimes may be zero in degenerate cases (rare here but schema preserved).
discrepancies.evidence: regime_metrics_long.csv r2_status column shows NOT_DEFINED label; we emit empty r2 cell.
discrepancies.impact: R² comparison not possible for those rare sub-regimes; not a scientific blocker.
discrepancies.resolution: Use approved Phase 50 NOT_DEFINED representation (empty r2 + r2_status=NOT_DEFINED).

discrepancies.description: Q25=50 and Q75=100 produce a degenerate Train R1 regime split because the distribution of Appliances Wh has heavy mass at low values (60% of Train ≤ 60 Wh).
discrepancies.evidence: regime_thresholds_train_only.json + manual inspection of Train raw_appliances distribution.
discrepancies.impact: TL_LOW and TL_MID cover roughly 50% / 25% of Test; TL_HIGH covers the upper ~25%. Conclusions about 'target level difficulty' should not be over-interpreted given the skew.
discrepancies.resolution: Reported in findings with explicit caveat; do NOT modify thresholds post-Stage B.

discrepancies.description: RMSE lift is reported in three forms (Wh, ratio, pct) to avoid conflation.
discrepancies.evidence: regime_rmse_lift.csv schema; regime_metrics_long.csv includes rmse_lift_wh, rmse_lift_ratio, rmse_lift_pct.
discrepancies.resolution: Documented in the Phase 50 plan and C50-I01 contract resolution.

discrepancies.description: Cross-seed aggregation uses sample SD (ddof=1) over 3 seed-level values, NOT a confidence interval.
discrepancies.impact: Per plan §22, seed SD is descriptive only.
